stock.description: Shougang Fushan Resources Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, with its primary operations in the People's Republic of China encompassing the extraction, exploration, processing, and distribution of both raw and clean coking coal. The company holds ownership and operational control over three key coal mines in Liulin County, Shanxi Province: the Xingwu mine, spanning approximately 11.6 square kilometers; the Jinjiazhuang mine, covering about 6.08 square kilometers; and the Zhaiyadi mine, which extends across roughly 13.9 square kilometers. Its principal customers are typically steel manufacturers. Founded in 1985, the enterprise was previously known as Fushan International Energy Group Limited until its rebranding to Shougang Fushan Resources Group Limited in May 2011. The company's corporate headquarters are situated in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
